csv_scope_of_work: The Indianapolis Public Transportation Corporation (dba IndyGo) is seeking a multidisciplinary planning, design, architectural and engineering (A&E) firm/team with expertise in structural, mechanical, electrical, plumbing, fire protection and related systems to assist with a flagship facility reset for the Julia M. title: A&E Services for Julia M. Carson Transit Center Renovations
short_description: Multidisciplinary design services for renovation of IndyGo's downtown transit center flagship facility.
project_location: Julia M. Carson Transit Center, 201 East Washington Street, Indianapolis, Indiana, USA
project_scope: Renovation and flagship facility reset of the Julia M. Carson Transit Center in downtown Indianapolis. The notice identifies a multidisciplinary building/infrastructure project requiring architectural and engineering input for structural, mechanical, electrical, plumbing, fire protection, civil, geotechnical, and public transit planning disciplines. No gross floor area, structural spans, or detailed technical quantities are stated.
services: Multidisciplinary planning, design, architectural and engineering services including architecture, civil engineering, geotechnical engineering, electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, structural engineering, plumbing, fire protection, and public transit planning.
relevance_explanation:
- Building renovation of a transit center, not a bridge or long-span special structure.
- Structural engineering is included, but the notice is dominated by broad multidisciplinary building systems scope.
- No information on large spans, innovative structural systems, lightweight construction, or architecturally exceptional features.
- Could offer limited entry via structural engineering within a larger A&E team, but overall fit for sbp appears moderate to low.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction budget is stated in the notice. Available cost-related context: renovation/reset of an existing flagship downtown transit center with multidisciplinary A&E scope including structural, MEP, fire protection, civil, and geotechnical services; funding sources are FTA, state, and local. This suggests a potentially medium-sized public renovation, but no realistic USD estimate can be derived from the provided text alone.
fee_explanation: No design fee or estimated professional services budget is stated in the notice. Only the requested multidisciplinary A&E scope and funding sources are provided, which are insufficient for a reliable fee estimate.
references_qualifications: Multidisciplinary A&E firm/team with expertise in structural, mechanical, electrical, plumbing, fire protection, and related systems; requested disciplines include architecture, civil engineering, geotechnical engineering, electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, structural engineering, and public transit planning. DBE participation goal: 10%.
